synthesis.headline: HCLTech meets EBIT margin targets, though revenue growth guidance remains difficult to verify against reported figures.

points.text: Management successfully delivered on the FY26 EBIT margin guidance of 17.0-18.0%, achieving an actual 17.17% margin.
FY27 EBIT margin guidance of 17.5-18.5% is currently on track, with a reported 17.46% margin for the first half.
Revenue growth guidance for FY26 and FY27 remains unverifiable due to discrepancies between constant currency targets and reported INR growth.

bull.text: Strong financial health with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08 and a high ROCE of 30.0%.
Consistent cash generation with a CFO/PAT ratio of 1.2 for the most recent fiscal year.

bear.text: Annual operating margins have trended downward from 26.6% in FY21 to 20.6% in FY26.
Annual PAT declined to 16,652.0 crore in FY26 from 17,399.0 crore in FY25.

business.what: HCL Technologies provides global technology services and software solutions, scaling rapidly in advanced AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and engineering services.
